_why: 13 weeks is the point where pages become markedly more likely to lose AI citations, and recency is the strongest single correlate of being cited. The ceiling is refresh capacity times that window: publish faster than the library can be maintained and the tail ages out of citability.

approved_expansions.reason: Completing the site's declared hyperlocal coverage: the four towns, three Memphis neighbourhoods and three hospitals the Search Readiness coverage manifest names and the site had never built, plus care-type pages for the four remaining towns with licensed communities in the facility directory. 18 pages, 36 URLs with their next-steps twins. The library lands at 177 against a ceiling of 195, so refresh capacity still covers it - which is the condition this allowance is checked against. The weekly cap of 5 resumes on the next run.

Sized to the ceiling: the library lands at 193 against 195, which is why eight smaller no-supply towns were folded by 301 instead of built. The weekly cap of 5 resumes on the next run.
